description: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services publish data on every certified nursing home in the United States in their Provider Data Catalog, the source behind the Care Compare website. The nursing home theme read on 2026-09-28 lists 18 datasets, including provider information, ownership of active homes, quality measures from Medicare claims, state and national averages of quality, staffing, fines and deficiencies, summaries of health, fire safety, infection control and complaint inspections over the past three years, inspection dates and a citation code look-up; each comes as a download, a data table, a data dictionary and an API. The files were last modified on 1 August 2026, with the next update planned for 30 September 2026. Coverage is the United States. Access is free; no licence is stated in the listing. Caveats: the data cover Medicare and Medicaid certified homes only, and location fields and bed counts sit in the provider file, which was not opened. It supports exposure and emergency studies, such as locating nursing homes and their residents in hurricane evacuation or heat-wave power outage zones and checking fire safety deficiencies. Related records: the CMS hospital data and New York's nursing home bed census.
